notes: Pass 7 Lane 0: every operation of the Docker Hub API spec (SOURCES.md pin hub_api, info.version 2-beta) has exactly one primary home; every spec tag is covered (hub_tag on the items, info_tags below). Names come only from the spec (DECISIONS.md).

planned: pass7 marks an item the Pass 7 build lanes implement: merge.py computes status `planned` while it is unregistered, registrygen and contractgen leave it out, validate.py S1 lists it without failing. The lane that registers the type removes the key (merge.py fails on a registered item that still says planned).

requires: org = the route is org-scoped; plan=<name> = a subscription the spec names; plan=unknown = a gated feature whose plan the spec does not state. No entry = reachable on a Personal plan as far as the spec says (the live probe, reference/_gen/pass7/hub-probe.md, can narrow it).

Provider block (Lane H, no inventory item): hub_username and hub_token, falling back to DOCKER_HUB_USERNAME and DOCKER_HUB_TOKEN; hub_token is sensitive. Every hub type exchanges them through POST /v2/auth/token (the docker_hub_token exchange) and caches the JWT per provider instance.
No owner label on Hub objects: no Hub object has a label field (CONTRACT.md Owner label, Excluded types).
Groups, not teams: the spec's tag and paths say group (the summaries add '(Team)'); every name uses group.

Docker Hardened Images and Docker Scout: the pinned spec has no tag or operation for either, so there is no item (DECISIONS.md: the spec is the only naming source). Re-harvest when the spec adds them (DriftCheck hub source).

info_tags.changelog: Info tag, no operations: points at the Hub API changelog. DriftCheck watches the spec itself (hub source kind).
info_tags.resources: Info tag, no operations: links the experimental hub-tool CLI. Not a naming source (DECISIONS.md: the spec only).
info_tags.rate-limiting: Info tag, no operations: X-RateLimit-Limit / -Remaining / -Reset headers. Lane H's Hub client must honour them (retry after Reset on 429); no Terraform type.
info_tags.authentication: Info tag, no operations: password / PAT / OAT auth types. Covered by ephemeral docker_hub_token (the /v2/auth/token exchange) and the provider arguments hub_username / hub_token (Lane H).

naming_questions: P7-Q1 docker_hub_repository and docker_hub_repository_group: the spec has no delete (and no update) route. Keep them as resources whose destroy only forgets (current), make create an action (docker_hub_repository_create), or defer both until the spec adds the routes?

P7-Q2 docker_hub_access_token: a JWT issued from a PAT is refused by /v2/access-tokens (403 'token issued from personal access token is not allowed', live probe). Managing PATs needs a password-issued JWT. Add a write-only hub_password provider argument for it, or ship the type documented as password-auth only?

items.name: docker_hub_token
items.summary: Exchange a username and a password, PAT or OAT for a short-lived Hub bearer JWT (POST /v2/auth/token); the JWT is sensitive and never stored.
Legacy login (POST /v2/users/login).
items.skip_reason: Legacy login route; the spec documents POST /v2/auth/token (ephemeral docker_hub_token) as the exchange, with the same identifier and secret.

items.summary: Second-factor login (POST /v2/users/2fa-login).
items.skip_reason: Needs an interactive TOTP code after a password login; Terraform runs unattended. A PAT or OAT through docker_hub_token needs no second factor.

items.name: docker_hub_access_token
items.summary: A personal access token. Label and is_active update in place; scopes and expires_at force replacement. The token value is returned once, by create: stored as the sensitive `token` and optionally written to secret_output_path.

items.name: docker_hub_access_tokens
items.summary: The personal access tokens of the authenticated user (paginated list; never the token values).

items.name: docker_hub_access_token
items.summary: One personal access token by UUID (metadata only; the value is never readable again).

items.name: docker_hub_audit_log_actions
items.summary: The audit log action names of a namespace, for filtering docker_hub_audit_logs (the spec returns a map by category).

items.name: docker_hub_audit_logs
items.summary: Audit log events of a namespace, filtered by action, name, actor and a from/to window; page_size bounds state.

items.name: docker_hub_org_settings
items.summary: An organization's settings (restricted_images). A singleton: create adopts the existing settings and PUTs them, delete only removes it from state (the spec has no delete). The spec: restricted_images is only used on a business subscription.

items.name: docker_hub_org_settings
items.summary: An organization's settings, read only.

items.name: docker_hub_org_access_token
items.summary: An organization access token (OAT). A separate item from docker_hub_access_token: org-scoped, with resource scopes. The value is returned once, by create: sensitive `token` and optional secret_output_path.

items.name: docker_hub_org_access_tokens
items.summary: The access tokens of an organization (paginated; never the values).

items.name: docker_hub_org_access_token
items.summary: One organization access token by ID (metadata only).

items.name: docker_hub_repository
items.summary: A Hub repository in a namespace (name, description, full_description, registry, is_private). The spec has create and read only: no update and no delete route, so every change replaces and destroy can only remove it from state (finding P7-F5).

items.name: docker_hub_repositories
items.summary: The repositories of a namespace (user or organization), filtered by name and ordered.

items.name: docker_hub_repository
items.summary: One repository of a namespace; public repositories read anonymously.

items.name: docker_hub_repository_tags
items.summary: The tags of a repository (paginated).

items.name: docker_hub_repository_tag
items.summary: One tag of a repository: its images per platform, size, status and push/pull times.

items.name: docker_hub_repository_immutable_tags
items.summary: A repository's immutable tags setting (enabled + rules). Read from the repository's immutable_tags_settings; delete PATCHes it off. Repository admin only (the spec).

items.name: docker_hub_repository_immutable_tags_verify
items.summary: Validate an immutable-tags regex and list the repository's tags it matches. A POST that changes nothing (the spec: validates and returns), so a data source.

items.name: docker_hub_repository_group
items.summary: An organization group's permission on a repository. The spec has only the assign route: no read and no delete (finding P7-F5).

items.name: docker_hub_org_members
items.summary: The members of an organization, filtered by search, type and role.

items.name: docker_hub_org_members_export
items.summary: The organization's members as the CSV the Hub exports (raw text only).

items.name: docker_hub_org_member
items.summary: An existing member's role in an organization. Members join through invites (docker_hub_invite), so create adopts the member and PUTs the role; delete removes the member from the organization.

items.name: docker_hub_org_invites
items.summary: The pending invites of an organization.

items.name: docker_hub_invite
items.summary: One invite of a Docker ID or email to an organization (and optionally a group, with a role), sent through the bulk route with one invitee; delete cancels it. Read finds it in the pending list.

items.name: docker_hub_invite_resend
items.summary: Resend a pending invite.

items.name: docker_hub_group
items.summary: A group of an organization (the spec's name; the Hub UI says team). Name and description update in place.

items.name: docker_hub_groups
items.summary: The groups of an organization, filtered by username or search.

items.name: docker_hub_group
items.summary: One group of an organization.

items.name: docker_hub_group_member
items.summary: A user's membership in a group. Read finds the member in the group's member list.

items.name: docker_hub_group_members
items.summary: The members of a group.

items.name: docker_hub_scim_service_provider_config
items.summary: The SCIM service provider configuration (SCIM token auth).

items.name: docker_hub_scim_resource_types
items.summary: The SCIM resource types.

items.name: docker_hub_scim_resource_type
items.summary: One SCIM resource type by name.

items.name: docker_hub_scim_schemas
items.summary: The SCIM schemas.

items.name: docker_hub_scim_schema
items.summary: One SCIM schema by ID.

items.name: docker_hub_scim_users
items.summary: The SCIM users of the organization (filter, sort, startIndex/count).

items.name: docker_hub_scim_user
items.summary: A SCIM-provisioned user. The spec has no delete: destroy PUTs active=false (deactivate), the spec's documented way to remove access.
